name: GenISys GmbH
summary: GenISys GmbH develops high-performance software solutions for optimizing micro- and nano-fabrication processes, focusing on lithography and inspection. Their products, such as BEAMER and TRACER, are widely used in electron-beam lithography, providing advanced pattern processing and proximity effect correction. They also offer metrology solutions like ProSEM and InSPEC for SEM-based inspection and measurement.
